text: dsh-acp-v1 是一个面向 Zed 桌面客户端的 DSH 插件，通过 Agent Client Protocol v1 把 DeepSeek Harness agent 接入 Zed Agent Panel。它以标准输入输出承载 ACP 消息，并把会话创建、提示和工具调用转交给 DSH agent。功能包括会话历史浏览与恢复、文本和受支持图片提示、命令与用户可调用技能列表，以及模型、思考级别和权限选项。适合希望在 Zed 中使用 DSH 编码 agent 的开发者。使用前需要 DSH、Zed 和 DeepSeek API key，也可使用 DSH Web 已保存的凭据。

dsh-acp-v1 brings DSH coding agents to Zed’s desktop Agent Panel over ACP v1. It supports session history, prompts with supported images, slash commands and skills, and model and permission choices. Requires DSH, Zed, and DeepSeek credentials.

dsh-acp-v1 的功能「会话历史」：可列出 DSH 会话，并加载、恢复或删除会话；加载时回放已提交内容。通过 ACP 历史操作触发。
dsh-acp-v1 的功能「命令与技能目录」：把 DSH 命令和用户可调用技能汇总为 ACP 可用命令，供 Zed 的斜杠菜单展示；技能选择后会转换为 DSH 可识别的斜杠形式。
dsh-acp-v1 的功能「会话选项」：为会话提供模型、思考级别和写入权限等配置选择，并根据 agent 当前能力生成选项；客户端可在会话创建后更新选择。
dsh-acp-v1 的功能「图片提示」：客户端声明支持且默认模型路线允许时，可在提示中提交 PNG、JPEG、WebP 或 GIF 图片；插件校验并持久化图片，再将其与文本按顺序组成 agent 提示。
dsh-acp-v1 使用前须知：需要配置 DeepSeek API key，可用 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY 或 DSH Web 保存的凭据；缺少凭据时认证会失败。（见 src/bridge/index.ts:1351-1373）

dsh-acp-v1 README · dsh-acp-v1：> **dsh-acp-v1 is, at heart, a dsh plugin**: it supplies the ACP
> capabilities missing from dsh's built-in ACP, and serves the DeepSeek
> Harness to the [Zed](https://zed.dev) editor as a custom ACP agent-server
> extension (an interactive ACP v1 server).

dsh-acp-v1 README · dsh-acp-v1：Run DeepSeek Harness agents inside Zed's Agent Panel over the
[Agent Client Protocol](https://agentclientprotocol.com) (v1): create/close
threads, stream text + reasoning, live tool cards, plan updates, slash
commands **and installed agent skills**, session history, permissions,
model/thought-level/preset selects, elicitation forms — while every tool runs
inside the dsh sandbox with dsh's own model route.

dsh-acp-v1 README · Requirements：- dsh CLI (tested on `0.2.0-rc.2`) — install globally first:

```bash
  npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.0-rc.2
  dsh --version   # → 0.2.0-rc.2
  ```

- pnpm (the `dsh plugin` command delegates to pnpm)
- Zed with the Agent Panel (ACP v1)
- A DeepSeek API key: `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` env var, or configured once in dsh
  Web (Models settings → writes `~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml`)

dsh-acp-v1 README · Install：The plugin is installed as a **profile bundle**. Pick a profile name (the
examples use `acp`); the boot command is then `dsh --profile acp`.

which also bundles the **official automation-only
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-acp-app`**. In that composition the official bridge answers
the client (`agentInfo.name = deepseek-harness-acp`, no `session/close`, no
live deltas) and this plugin never gets the connection.

dsh-acp-v1 README · Configure Zed：- `command: "dsh"` assumes `dsh` is on `PATH` (npm global install). If a
  GUI-launched Zed cannot find it, start Zed from a terminal that has `dsh`
  on `PATH`, or set `command` to the absolute path of the `dsh` binary.
- Then start a new thread from the Agent Panel and pick
  `DeepSeek Harness (acp)`. The thread toolbar offers Preset (while the session
  is still blank), plus the Model / Thought Level / Write permission selects.
- `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` is optional in `agent_servers[].env` — without it dsh uses
  the credentials already stored by dsh Web.

dsh-acp-v1 README · Smoke test (no model key needed)：stdout must contain **only** JSON-RPC; EOF must exit 0:

```bash
printf '%s\n%s\n' \
  '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"initialize","params":{"protocolVersion":1,"clientCapabilities":{}}}' \
  '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":2,"method":"session/new","params":{"cwd":"/tmp","mcpServers":[]}}' |
  dsh --profile acp

Expect two `result` frames (initialize → protocolVersion 1, session/new →
sessionId), then exit 0.

dsh-acp-v1 README · Capabilities (declared only when implemented)：- Sessions: `session/new · list · load · resume · close · delete` with durable
  history (session-query/persistence); `load` replays committed content per
  ACP semantics.
- Streaming/rendering: `agent_message_chunk`, streamed reasoning, tool cards
  (execute cards carry the concrete command line in their title), plan/todo
  updates, `usage_update`, `available_commands_update` slash catalog = dsh
  command plane **+ user-invocable skills** (`~/.agents/skills`,
  `<project>/.agents/skills`, `.dsh/skills`). Skills follow the pi-acp naming
  convention: announced as `skill:<name>` (`/skill:find-skills` in the `/`
  popup), commands keep plain names; picking one loads the skill body through
  dsh's `tool-skill` pre-step.
- Command output display (Zed 1.18): Zed renders execute-kind cards as
  terminal-style cards whose text content hides behind a hover-only chevron
  (an external agent cannot force them open), so every bash/pwsh result is
  delivered as a read-style card: the title carries the model-written command
  description (the raw command line stays in rawInput) and the captured
  output rides as fenced text conte

dsh-acp-v1 README · Capabilities (declared only when implemented)：Honestly **not** implemented (never advertised): session fork, delegated
terminal/fs **execution** (commands run only in the dsh sandbox — the client
renders captured output as card content, it never executes the agent's
command), `additionalDirectories`,
audio/embeddedContext, MCP mounting (non-empty `mcpServers` is accepted and
ignored — no MCP tools are mounted, noted on stderr), fine-grained diff
cards, Windows.

dsh-acp-v1 README · Presets & model route (deployment fields)：The agent preset and the default model route are deployment fields, read from
the environment **once at boot** (changing them means restarting the agent):

dsh-acp-v1 README · Presets & model route (deployment fields)：- `DSH_ACP_PRESET` — the preset every ACP session is composed from (default
  `standard`; the roster this bundle ships: `standard`, `ptc`, `minimal`,
  `cordis`). A value no installed preset supplies fails `session/new` with a
  readable error listing the available presets. This bundle ships the host rows
  the non-`standard` presets need (`cordis-host-runner` +
  `cordis-inspect-providers` for creator mode; the terminal / tool-presentation
  packages are devDependencies), so a base-only profile — and the standalone
  dev boot — mounts all four.
- `DSH_ACP_PROVIDER` / `DSH_ACP_MODEL` — the shipped default route
  (`deepseek-official` / `deepseek-v4-flash`); the per-session Model config
  option still overrides.

dsh-acp-v1 README · Presets & model route (deployment fields)：Presets are a deployment default **and** a blank-session session option. A new
thread advertises a **Preset** selector: while the session has produced no
turn, picking another preset recomposes the agent — tool set, prompt sections,
skills — the same switch dsh Web performs. dsh fixes the composition at the
first turn (`agent-preset/locked`), so the bridge drops the selector at
`turn/start`: after that the preset is a property of the session and only a new
thread can change it. A reloaded session re-mounts the preset its log last
selected, not the one `DSH_ACP_PRESET` names now.

dsh-acp-v1 README · Presets & model route (deployment fields)：On dsh 0.2.0 the preset roster is declarative: the registry scans no
directories, so this bundle ships the four compositions as
`presets/<id>.patch.yml` (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset` rows, listed in
`package.json` `dsh.bundle.patch`) and disables dsh-base's agent-plane rows so
each session's preset owns its tool surface. Add a preset the same way a
deployment does: insert a `@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset` row from your
profile's own `cordis.patch.yml`. A preset whose composition cannot mount is
not offered (and a direct pick fails with a readable error).

dsh-acp-v1 README · Develop：```bash
pnpm install
pnpm typecheck   # tsc --noEmit
pnpm build       # tsdown -> lib/
pnpm test        # vitest (175 tests incl. spawned frame-purity + history probes)

The dev/probe boot composes `@deepseek-ai/dsh-base` + every `dsh.bundle.patch`
layer of this package (`cordis.patch.yml` then `presets/*.patch.yml`). Set
`DSH_ACP_DEV_PATCH=<patch.yml>` to append one more layer — the way the probes
author a preset, since the 0.2.0 registry scans no directories.

dsh-acp-v1 README · Develop：Layout: `src/bridge/index.ts` (plugin entry), `catalog.ts` (slash catalog),
`replay.ts` (history → ACP frames), `tool-cards.ts` (card titles/kinds),
`{codec,updates,content,config-options,session-store}.ts` (wire builders /
decision tables), `src/dev-bin.ts` (isolated dev/test boot),
`cordis.patch.yml` + `presets/*.patch.yml` (bundle patch).
